items.explanation: Only zaydun qāʾimun gives a complete meaning; the others leave the listener waiting.

items.arabic: الكَلَامُ هُوَ اللَّفْظُ المُرَكَّبُ المُفِيدُ بِالوَضْعِ
options: The composed utterance that gives benefit by convention
A single word with a single meaning
A word that names a time
items.explanation: The definition asks for an utterance, composed of words, that gives a complete benefit, by the convention of the Arabs.

items.prompt: What is the least that kalām needs?
options: Two words that complete a meaning
items.explanation: A noun with a noun (zaydun qāʾimun) or a verb with a noun (qāma zaydun) is enough.
